# Ñāṇavibhaṅga (Vb 16)

**ID:** Vb 16  
**Section:** Vibhaṅga (vb)  
**Collection:** Abhidhamma  
**Title (Pali):** Ñāṇavibhaṅga  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh02m.mul15.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh02m.mul15.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Ñāṇavibhaṅga* ("Analysis of Knowledge") constitutes the sixteenth chapter of the *Vibhaṅga*, the second book of the Theravāda *Abhidhamma Piṭaka* [Endo 1997; von Hinüber 1996]. The treatise provides a systematic categorization and analytical exposition of knowledge (*ñāṇa*), arranged methodically according to an ascending numerical principle akin to that of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* [von Hinüber 1996]. Within its classification of knowledge, it elaborates in detail upon doctrinal sets such as the ten powers of a Tathāgata (*dasatathāgatabala*) [Endo 1997].

- Mentioned in: an1.277; Mil 6.1.1 Dvinnaṁbuddhānaṁanuppajjamānapañha; Ne 21 Vicayahārasampāta; DN 28 (PTS DN iii 99) Sampasādanīya Sutta; MN 115 (PTS MN iii 61) Bahudhātuka Sutta; AN 10.21 Sīhanādasutta; Ps 2.9 Balakathā; AN 6.64 Sīhanādasutta; MN 12 (PTS MN i 68) Mahāsīhanāda Sutta

**Sources**

- [Endo 1997] Toshiichi Endo, Buddha in Theravada Buddhism: A Study of the Concept of Buddha in the Pali Commentaries (1997) — Identifies chapter 16 of the Vibhaṅga as the Ñāṇavibhaṅga and notes its detailed exposition of the ten tathāgatabalas
- [von Hinüber 1996] Oskar von Hinüber, A Handbook of Pāli Literature (1996) — Notes the chapter numbering and its numerical arrangement parallel to the Aṅguttara Nikāya
